tool.name: Mdfeaturizer
tool.description: : Obtain the Molecular Dynamics Features for PyTorch model training.

param.name: input_trajectory_path
param.label: input XTC,DCD file
param.help: Path to the input trajectory file (if omitted topology file is used as trajectory). Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_topology_path
param.label: input PDB file
param.help: Path to the input topology file. Format: [input].pdb

param.name: outname_output_dataset_pt_path
param.label: output PT name
param.help: Path to the output dataset model file Format: [output].pt

param.name: outname_output_stats_pt_path
param.label: output PT name
param.help: Path to the output model statistics file Format: [output].pt

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: cartesian
param.label: cartesian
param.help: Atom selection options for Cartesian coordinates feature generation (e.g. selection, fit_selection). (Json)

param.name: distances
param.label: distances
param.help: Atom selection options for pairwise distance features (selection, cutoff, periodic, bonded, etc.). (Json)

param.name: angles
param.label: angles
param.help: Atom selection options for angle features (selection, periodic, bonded, etc.). (Json)

param.name: dihedrals
param.label: dihedrals
param.help: Atom selection options for dihedral features (selection, periodic, bonded, etc.). (Json)
